root_idea.summary: The root centers on swallowing or drawing something into oneself.
root_idea.development: This ingesting image extends to things that take in water, such as drains and the opening of a pulley, and to related expressions of absorption or spreading. Specialized derivatives name the gullet, a gulp, and other objects associated with swallowing.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic imperative is normalized to the standard Form I perfect citation form بَلَعَ.

senses.definition: To swallow up, absorbing or taking something into oneself.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the verb is an imperative addressed to the earth, with water as the object: the earth is commanded to take the water back into itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an idiomatic use, to swallow one’s spittle, meaning to restrain one’s anger.
Of grayness or hoariness, to begin appearing or to spread over the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the appearance and spread of gray hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or enable someone to swallow something; by extension, to give someone time to swallow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression أَبْلِعْنِي رِيقِي means “give me time to swallow my spittle.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A voracious eater, one who swallows large mouthfuls or everything.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet for a person; the evidence does not require a gender-specific restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lunar mansion consisting of two nearby stars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A traditional proper name associated with the image of swallowing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hole or perforation in a pulley, especially in the pulley’s central frame or apparatus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical noun; the form may also function as a collective or plural designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gulp, or the amount of beverage swallowed at one time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Comparable to a جرعة, a draught or measured swallow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who eats much and swallows food vehemently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive descriptive epithet for a heavy or forceful eater.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The gullet or oesophagus, the passage through the throat for food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can also be extended to the throat or fauces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A torrent that enters and disappears into the earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded specifically of a torrent entering ground of the type called قُفّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The whitish mark at the edge of an ass’s mouth or on its lip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical or descriptive use.
A substantivized noun for a swallowable medicinal preparation.
A substantivized use related to something drunk or swallowed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wide cooking pot that takes in whatever is thrown into it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or tropical description based on the pot’s capacity to “swallow” its contents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sinkhole, drain, or hole into which water descends; also a narrow-headed well in a house that receives rainwater and the like.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A domestic drainage feature, especially one situated in the middle of a house.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well lined with stones or baked bricks from the bottom to the rim.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for a constructed, masonry-lined well.

cautions: The Quran-attested surface form is the imperative ٱبْلَعِى addressed to the earth; the public headword is normalized to the Form I perfect بَلَعَ.

The traditional lunar-mansion entry for سَعْدُ بُلَعَ associates its name with the Quranic command concerning the earth and its water; that association is not treated as an additional Quran word occurrence.
